targeted_candidate.direction: larger image-referenced orientation angle with higher annual precipitation

direction_rule: nodding group must have a larger median than the upright group for directional concordance
inference_rule: targeted external-consistency pilot; report exact one-sided group permutation, exact Mann-Whitney and descriptive Spearman results; no new multiplicity family and no candidate promotion
evidence_rule: include only authoritative botanical accounts with an explicit orientation statement; equivocal or developmental-stage-dependent accounts remain in the audit table but are excluded from the strict binary comparison
claim_boundary: The pilot does not change the primary full-27 atlas, multiplicity families, broad-space gate or final candidate set.
Species-level botanical descriptions are not independent individual-level gravity measurements.
A categorical literature state cannot validate continuous camera geometry or developmental-stage effects.
The pilot does not close the independent detector, reference-measurement, developmental-stage, colour-control or repeat-photo gates.
No additional traits or environmental predictors are screened.
